entity_types: Foundation (yutthathikam) under the Foundation Act B.E. 2550, registered with the Ministry of Justice; registered association under the Civil and Commercial Code Part 2, with a board of at least 3 members.
cost_time: Registry fee ~USD 11 for a foundation (THB 210) and ~USD 68 for an association (THB 2,005); processing a few weeks, unpublished; tax status filed separately with the Revenue Department.

entity_types: Non-governmental organization under Decree 125/2020; charitable fund under Decree 03/2026 with citizen founders; foreign NGOs may operate only via a Representative Office under Decree 58/2022.
cost_time: Foreigners cannot found a local charity; foreign NGOs only via a Representative Office with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs; domestic fundraising needs a separate permit - effectively barred.

entity_types: Non-stock non-profit corporation under the Revised Corporation Code, filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission via eSPARC; registered foundation as a variant; DOLE registration for some associations.
cost_time: SEC filing plus notarization roughly USD 100-150, several weeks for the certificate; foreign persons may be members or officers, but the secretary must be a Filipino citizen and resident.

entity_types: Registered society under the Societies Act, Chap. 203, with the Registrar of Societies (Royal Brunei Police, Gadong); charitable societies must adopt a constitution per the Act's Second Schedule.
cost_time: Registry fee payable in cash after approval but unpublished; weeks to register; foreigners may join but a society must be Brunei-centric in character, limiting practical non-resident access.

entity_types: Non-profit associations and foundations under Decree-Law 5/2005; an association gains juridical personality on registration with the Ministry of Justice, effective against third parties after gazette publication.
cost_time: Registration fee unpublished; gazette publication adds weeks; a foreign NGO must appoint a local permanent representative with full powers to represent it - a hard practical barrier for non-residents.

entity_types: Incorporated society under the Incorporated Societies Act 2022 (in force from 6 April 2026) registered with the Companies Office; charitable status is a separate registration with the Charities Commission.
cost_time: Registration fee NZ$88.89 plus GST (~USD 75) under the Incorporated Societies Regulations 2023 s7; processing usually a few days to weeks; foreign founders welcome, residency not required.

entity_types: Company limited by guarantee under the Companies Act 2015 - the standard charitable form - registered with the Registrar of Companies; a registered club as a lighter alternative.
cost_time: Prescribed fee FJD$45 (~USD 62); a few weeks for the certificate; an officeholder must be an ordinary resident of Fiji, so a non-resident founder needs a local nominee director.

entity_types: Company limited by guarantee under the Companies Act 1997 via the IPA registry; associations under the Associations Incorporation Act 2023, whose supporting regulations commence 1 July 2026, replacing the 1966 Act.
cost_time: Incorporation fees in the low hundreds of USD (in PNGK); a few weeks; an associations pathway arrives mid-2026; foreign participation in charities is restricted in practice.

entity_types: Company limited by guarantee under the Companies Act 2001, registered with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, the standard form for charities and NGOs; trusts under separate trustee rules.
cost_time: Filing fee roughly USD 50-100 (amount unpublished); processing a few weeks; a company must have a Samoan-resident registered office, so non-resident founders need a local agent or resident director.

entity_types: Registered charitable trust under the Charitable Trusts Act 1993 with the Registrar of Charitable Trusts, incorporated as a Board; company limited by guarantee under the Companies Act.
cost_time: Trustee fee unpublished; a few weeks for incorporation; a trust must have a Tongan-resident trustee and a local office, so non-resident founders need a local co-trustee - a hard practical barrier.

entity_types: Company limited by guarantee under the Companies Act 2012, registered with the Financial Services Commission, the main charitable form; trusts registered under trustee regulations.
cost_time: Registration fee VT35,000 (~USD 330) via the online registry; processing a few days to weeks; a Vanuatu resident officeholder is required, so a non-resident founder must appoint a local director.

entity_types: Company limited by guarantee under the Companies Act 2009 with the Solomon Islands Business Registry; charitable trusts under trustee rules; a company limited by guarantee is the standard NGO form.
cost_time: Incorporation fee roughly USD 50-150, paid at the Treasury counter after online application; a few weeks; a resident company secretary is required, so a local agent is needed.

entity_types: Company under the Companies Ordinance 1979 as amended, registered by the Business and Companies Regulatory Division in Tarawa; associations and trusts under registration rules.
cost_time: Fees unpublished; a few weeks; a Foreign Investment Certificate from the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Cooperatives is required for foreign incorporation, making non-resident setup hard.

entity_types: Trusts under the Trusts Act, corporations under the Corporations Act 1972, both registered by the Department of Justice and Border Control; no dedicated charitable registration regime exists.
cost_time: Trust registration fee unpublished; processing a few weeks; there is no established charitable registration regime and a local agent on the island is required, making foreign incorporation very hard.

entity_types: Company under the Companies Act (Cap 40.08) and the Companies and Business Registration Act, administered by the Ministry of Finance; international companies under a 2009 Act.
cost_time: Fees are set by regulation and unpublished; registration is effectively reserved to Tuvaluan nationals and local business - practically barred for a foreign founder without a resident partner.

entity_types: Non-resident domestic corporation under the Business Corporations Act 1981, with The Trust Company of the Marshall Islands as registered agent; trusts under the Trusts Act 1994.
cost_time: Registry fees plus agent fees, roughly USD 500-1000 in year one; incorporation within a few days to a week; the non-resident domestic route is explicitly designed for foreign founders.

entity_types: Corporations and non-profit associations under the FSM Corporations Act (FSMC Title 36), registered with the FSM Registrar of Corporations; state-level registration for local business.
cost_time: Filing fee roughly USD 50-200, unpublished in detail; a few weeks; foreign founders may incorporate without local presence, with a registered agent in Pohnpei serving filings.

entity_types: Foundation (vakif) under the Foundations Law No. 5737, requiring legal and factual reciprocity for foreigners; association (dernek) under the Associations Law No. 2860, registered with the provincial governor.
cost_time: Foundation registration fee around USD 70-140 plus notary and translation, a few weeks to months; an association costs little; foreign founders are allowed for vakif where reciprocity applies.
